plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Aviat Networks microwave radios (enterprise PEN 2509, AVIAT-RXPERFORMANCE-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports per-radio receive signal level (current, mean, maximum and minimum).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: aviat_rx_rsl_current_dbm
metrics.description: Current receive signal level of an Aviat microwave radio in dBm, from aviatRxPerformRslReadingCurrent. The device reports 0.1 dBm steps; the stored value is divided by 10.

metrics.name: aviat_rx_rsl_mean_dbm
metrics.description: Mean receive signal level of an Aviat microwave radio in dBm, from aviatRxPerformRslReadingMean. The device reports 0.1 dBm steps; the stored value is divided by 10.

metrics.name: aviat_rx_rsl_max_dbm
metrics.description: Maximum receive signal level of an Aviat microwave radio in dBm, from aviatRxPerformRslReadingMax. The device reports 0.1 dBm steps; the stored value is divided by 10.

metrics.name: aviat_rx_rsl_min_dbm
metrics.description: Minimum receive signal level of an Aviat microwave radio in dBm, from aviatRxPerformRslReadingMin. The device reports 0.1 dBm steps; the stored value is divided by 10.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
